# Poor Clares of Brigid's Hill

> Contemplative nuns living the Gospel in poverty, enclosure and joy, and praying for the world day and night.

- Order: Poor Clare nuns
- Place: Brigid's Hill
- Founded: 1928
- Address: 12 Monastery Lane, Brigid's Hill, OH 44000, United States
- Email: sisters@example.org
- Vocations: discern@example.org
- Phone: (555) 010-0177

## Pages

- [Home](index.html): welcome, times of prayer, coming events
- [Our life](about.html): charism, daily life and history
- [Horarium](horarium.html): the daily schedule of prayer, with the hours open to the public
- [Vocations](vocations.html): who may apply, the stages of formation, Come and See retreats, the inquiry form
- [Visit](visit.html): Mass, the guesthouse, retreats and directions
- [Events](events.html): upcoming feasts and retreats
- [Prayer requests](prayer.html): send a prayer intention
- [Shop](shop.html): goods the community makes
- [Give](give.html): online giving, cheques, Mass intentions, current needs, bequests
- [Contact](contact.html): address, phone and email
- [Privacy](privacy.html): what the site does with what you send
